COLOR_GROUPS = [("black", 3), ("brown", 2), ("crimson", 2), ("gold", 1), ("gray", 2),

                ("yellow", 2)]

orig_colors = []

assert len(orig_colors) == 30 and len(RAW) == 30

initial = [dict(size=s, origin=o, material=m, smell=sm, kind=k, color=c)
           for (s, o, m, sm, k), c in zip(RAW, orig_colors)]
initial_pairs = {(it["smell"], it["color"]) for it in initial}

# Step 1: drop every item type that occurs an even number of times
kind_counts = Counter(it["kind"] for it in initial)
coll = [dict(it) for it in initial if kind_counts[it["kind"]] % 2 == 1]
removed_types = sorted(k for k, n in kind_counts.items() if n % 2 == 0)

# Step 2: mom gives a magenta copy for each red item present
for it in [i for i in coll if i["color"] == "red"]:
    coll.append(dict(it, color="magenta", origin="Chinese", size="medium",

# Step 3: sister recolors steel items and sets smell to popcorn.

EXPECT_COLOR = Counter({"brown": 11, "gold": 1, "gray": 1, "green": 1, "ivory": 1,
                        "khaki": 1, "magenta": 1, "red": 2, "white": 1, "yellow": 1})

def sister_trial(c):
    out = []
    for it in coll:
        d = dict(it)
        if d["material"] == "steel":
            d["color"] = c
            d["smell"] = "popcorn"
        out.append(d)
    return out

sister_matches = [c for c, _ in COLOR_GROUPS

assert len(sister_matches) == 1
sister_color = sister_matches[0]
coll = sister_trial(sister_color)

EXPECT_MAT = Counter({"steel": 10, "plastic": 7, "glass": 2, "ceramic": 2})

def aunt_trial(m):

    repl = [dict(i, material=m, smell="lavender") for i in coll if i["size"] == "extra-small"]
    return keep + repl

def qualifies(it):
